---
pagetitle: "Malek M. Itani"
description-meta: "Research, writing, and prototypes"
page-layout: full
toc: false
format:
  html:
    css:
      - styles.css
      - home.css
listing:
  - id: featured
    contents:
      - "research/*/index.qmd"
      - "prototypes/*/index.qmd"
    # Shows only pages whose front matter sets `featured: true`.
    # Order comes from `featured-order` (1 first); pages without one fall to
    # the end, most recent first.
    include:
      featured: true
    type: grid
    grid-columns: 3
    grid-item-border: false
    image-height: 160px
    fields: [image, title, description, categories]
    sort:
      - "featured-order"
      - "date desc"
    max-items: 6
    max-description-length: 110
    sort-ui: false
    filter-ui: false
    categories: false
    feed: false
  - id: recent-writing
    contents: "blog/posts"
    type: default
    fields: [date, title, description]
    sort: "date desc"
    max-items: 4
    max-description-length: 140
    sort-ui: false
    filter-ui: false
    categories: false
    image-align: right
---
